parsed.name: Nanonis扫描探针显微镜控制器
parsed.description: 这是一类用于扫描探针显微镜实验的控制器与控制电子学设备，常见于扫描隧道显微镜和原子力显微镜平台。它用于连接主机与显微镜系统，执行实验控制、扫描过程协调以及测量数据交互，适合实验室中的自动化显微测量与仪器联动。
parsed.description_en: This is a controller and control-electronics unit used in scanning probe microscopy experiments, commonly paired with STM and AFM platforms. It connects the host computer to the microscope system and is used for experiment control, scan coordination, and measurement data exchange in automated laboratory microscopy workflows.
